# @kimen/elements — Kimen web components

> Kimen web components (ki-*). Standards-first Stencil components, tokens-only styling, agent-legible by contract.

Install with `pnpm add @kimen/elements @kimen/tokens`.

Register each component before using it. Every component is exported from
`@kimen/elements/<tag>`, the way `ki-button` is here:

```ts
import { defineCustomElement as defineKiButton } from '@kimen/elements/ki-button';
import '@kimen/tokens/css';
import '@kimen/tokens/css/base';

defineKiButton();
```

Load `@kimen/tokens/css` once per page: it is the onmars default theme and
the only stylesheet the components require. It declares every `--ki-*` token
for both schemes together with the `color-scheme` they resolve from, so a
page follows its visitor's light or dark preference with no further setup.
`@kimen/tokens/css/base` — the page contract — is optional: it paints the
page background, text color and body font from those tokens and declares no
color scheme of its own. Without it the page keeps the browser's own canvas
and text color for the active scheme, and every component stays legible on
it.

Human-readable documentation: https://kimen.dev/docs/

This file is an index: read it first, then only the documents the task
needs. Each entry under Components says when to use that component; its
document is the complete contract — attributes, slots, parts, events,
methods, CSS custom properties and examples.

## Components

- [ki-alert](llms/ki-alert.md): show a persistent inline message about the state of a page or section, such as a failed save, completed operation, or service notice, that remains until the condition is resolved or the person dismisses it.
- [ki-avatar](llms/ki-avatar.md): a compact identity visual for a person or entity — a comment author, a contact list item, a project member.
- [ki-avatar-group](llms/ki-avatar-group.md): a compact "who is involved" stack — the members of a shared document, project card or event row — where space deserves only the first few identities and an exact "+N" counter accounts for the rest.
- [ki-badge](llms/ki-badge.md): annotate an entity with short status text (a state, a category) whose meaning is carried by the label itself; the tone color only reinforces the text, it never replaces it.
- [ki-button](llms/ki-button.md): trigger the single main action of a view, supporting actions in descending hierarchy, or confirming/destructive actions through tone.
- [ki-card](llms/ki-card.md): group related media, a title, supporting text and actions into one scannable surface.
- [ki-checkbox](llms/ki-checkbox.md): selecting one or more independent options that a form submits later, including a "select all" parent that presents partial selection with `indeterminate`.
- [ki-checkbox-group](llms/ki-checkbox-group.md): people may select several visible options that share a question, form field, and optional selection limits.
- [ki-chip](llms/ki-chip.md): apply independent filters, represent values selected in an entry field, or offer a small contextual action alongside content.
- [ki-chip-group](llms/ki-chip-group.md): label related chips or let people change their reading order.
- [ki-counter](llms/ki-counter.md): mark unread or pending items on a trigger, or presence on an avatar.
- [ki-dialog](llms/ki-dialog.md): destructive confirmations, blocking choices, and brief critical input that must be resolved before returning to the page.
- [ki-divider](llms/ki-divider.md): visually separate adjacent content when spacing alone is not enough: grouped settings sections, toolbar action groups, distinct regions inside a card — horizontal between stacked content, vertical between side-by-side content.
- [ki-grid](llms/ki-grid.md): lay out items on responsive tracks with consistent token spacing.
- [ki-icon](llms/ki-icon.md): show a named glyph next to text, or give a standalone meaningful glyph an accessible label.
- [ki-icon-button](llms/ki-icon-button.md): a compact, widely understood action where space precludes a visible label: toolbars, card and dialog corners (close), media transport, data-row actions.
- [ki-image](llms/ki-image.md): to show a photo, illustration, or diagram with a predictable layout.
- [ki-indicator](llms/ki-indicator.md): show the current position within a bounded, sequential set of peer views whose navigation lives elsewhere: carousel slides, unlabeled onboarding steps, gallery pages.
- [ki-input](llms/ki-input.md): collect one line of free text from a person, always with a visible `label`; choose the `type` and `autocomplete` that match the entry purpose.
- [ki-link](llms/ki-link.md): navigate to a page, section, or resource.
- [ki-list](llms/ki-list.md): settings, contacts, results or activity feeds where each item composes leading media, primary text, optional secondary text and trailing meta or a slotted control.
- [ki-list-item](llms/ki-list-item.md): only as a child of `ki-list`, for one read-only entry in a similar vertical collection.
- [ki-note](llms/ki-note.md): Add a short constraint, tip or consequence next to the content it explains.
- [ki-option](llms/ki-option.md): declare one choice inside a `ki-select`; its text is the human-facing label and its `value` is the submitted value.
- [ki-progress](llms/ki-progress.md): communicate advancement of an ongoing task such as upload, download, installation or multi-step processing.
- [ki-qr](llms/ki-qr.md): hand a URL or machine-readable payload from the screen to a nearby camera device: login pairing, tickets and passes, "continue on mobile" links, Wi-Fi sharing.
- [ki-radio](llms/ki-radio.md): place inside `ki-radio-group` when a person must choose exactly one of a small visible set.
- [ki-radio-group](llms/ki-radio-group.md): a person must choose exactly one of a small set of mutually exclusive options that should all be visible at once.
- [ki-scroller](llms/ki-scroller.md): a bounded region inside a view whose content can outgrow it: chat or message panes, code and log blocks, tag rows, sidebar navigation, tall menus inside cards.
- [ki-segment](llms/ki-segment.md): offer one mutually exclusive choice with text or a named icon.
- [ki-segmented-control](llms/ki-segmented-control.md): apply a chart range, view mode, or another immediate setting.
- [ki-select](llms/ki-select.md): choose exactly one value from a known closed list, especially when there are roughly five or more choices or space is limited.
- [ki-skeleton](llms/ki-skeleton.md): Reserve the expected layout of a card, list, or assistant reply while it loads.
- [ki-spinner](llms/ki-spinner.md): show brief inline activity such as saving a change or running a tool.
- [ki-stack](llms/ki-stack.md): arrange content in a vertical sequence or a horizontal row with consistent token spacing.
- [ki-status](llms/ki-status.md): mark a state with minimal footprint adjacent to (or overlaid on) the item it describes: presence on an avatar, health of a service list entry, connection state in a toolbar.
- [ki-switch](llms/ki-switch.md): binary settings whose change takes effect immediately, always with a slotted label.
- [ki-tab](llms/ki-tab.md): label one peer content view inside `ki-tabs`, with optional `start` and `end` slot media.
- [ki-tab-panel](llms/ki-tab-panel.md): hold the content for one peer tab view, sharing `value` with its `ki-tab`.
- [ki-tabs](llms/ki-tabs.md): switch between small sets of peer views inside the same page, with one visible panel at a time.
- [ki-textarea](llms/ki-textarea.md): free-form text longer than one line, such as comments, descriptions, messages, delivery notes, or addresses when paired with a matching `autocomplete` purpose.
- [ki-toast](llms/ki-toast.md): confirm an action that happened elsewhere on screen ("Changes saved", "Link copied"), report a background result ("Export ready"), or offer a quick undo.
- [ki-toaster](llms/ki-toaster.md): once per page (or once inside a modal `ki-dialog`), as the place every `ki-toast` of the application appears in: append toasts to it, or call `show()`.
- [ki-tooltip](llms/ki-tooltip.md): add a brief clarifying hint for an icon-only, abbreviated, or otherwise ambiguous control when the same information is discoverable elsewhere in the interface.
- [ki-video](llms/ki-video.md): playable content the person deliberately chooses to watch — product tours, talks, tutorials, announcements — presented as a poster with one play control.

## Guides

- [Theming](llms/theming.md): All themes reassign the same `--ki-*` custom properties, so switching themes restyles every component with no code changes.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): everything in one file — this guidance and every component contract. Large: fetch it only when the whole library is needed at once.
- [custom-elements.json](generated/custom-elements.json): the same component contracts as a Custom Elements Manifest (JSON).
